cues.text: As if in a trance, you gaze up at the pale full moon -
until a strange noise from the mountain to the north tears you out of your thoughts:
it is the same noise you heard back then in the overgrown graveyard of the old,
ruined monastery - only this time you no longer feel any fear - no, on the contrary:
in a very strange way the noise even seems familiar to you,
seems to call you, to lure you...?
All of a sudden you feel a burning pain in your chest,
as if a dark power wanted to take possession of your body from within!
Out of your mind with pain, you want to tear the shirt off your body - and freeze:
your chest is covered all over with shaggy black hair,
just like your arms - and after a few more agonising seconds, your whole body!
You try to scream, but you don't recognise your own voice:
instead of a human cry of pain, what comes out of your throat is - A WOLF'S HOWL...!
Feverishly you try to fight down your panic and think clearly:
apparently the wound the werewolf gave you during your midnight duel in the neglected
monastery graveyard was not quite as harmless
after all as you had naively assumed at first!
You could slap yourself with anger, but it doesn't help...
Hoping that King Richard will find a way to
cure you once you have escaped these cursed walls,
you decide to put off any further thoughts about your hairy future for now...
